description: This file contains shell script code for testing the 'git-http-backend' functionality in a server environment. It sets up test environment variables, defines functions to run backend commands and send HTTP GET and POST requests, and includes test cases to validate server behavior with various PATH_INFO inputs.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Runs the git http-backend command with given query string and path, redirecting output to files for comparison.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request by invoking run_backend and verifying the response status.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with specified content type and data, then checks the response status.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Checks if the backend correctly handles path aliasing or blocking, based on input parameter.
